3.1.2/8.source_en: Hungry? I eat. Want something? I take. Hate something? Perish and be happy without it!!!

3.1.2/11.speaker: you
3.1.2/11.source_en: Don't even dare talking yourself down like that! You have a lot going for you.

3.1.2/12.speaker: you
3.1.2/12.source_en: First of all, I think you look very pretty; and second, you clearly are-

3.1.2/13.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/13.source_en: You... really think I look pretty?

3.1.2/16.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/16.source_en: Wait, do you think as his spine?

3.1.2/17.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/17.source_en: Do you see as his spine?

3.1.2/18.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/18.source_en: Are you talking to me, as his spine?

3.1.2/20.speaker: you
3.1.2/20.source_en: Sorta? I mean, I don't know exactly, but-

3.1.2/21.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/21.source_en: Are you looking at me, through his eyes?

3.1.2/26.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/26.source_en: I am Idimya! I am on a date with your spine! Nice to meet you!

3.1.2/27.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/27.source_en: Psst, does this human think I am pretty, too?

3.1.2/29.speaker: you
3.1.2/29.source_en: He says you are very attractive as well as kind and merciful!

3.1.2/32.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/32.source_en: So, you and this human live together, as one?

3.1.2/33.speaker: you
3.1.2/33.source_en: Oh... uh, yeah! Exactly! I actually let him keep his brain and stuff! Haha! The way he thinks is just... never a dull moment!

3.1.2/35.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/35.source_en: So, how do you control the spine? The REAL you?

3.1.2/36.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/36.source_en: Do you become the spine? Replace it? Wrap around it?

3.1.2/38.speaker: you
3.1.2/38.source_en: Somewhere along those lines, for sure, yeah...

3.1.2/40.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/40.source_en: How do you think as his spine? You said he thinks? But you also think?

3.1.2/41.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/41.source_en: How do you see as his spine? You said he sees, but you see what he sees?

3.1.2/42.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/42.source_en: How are you talking to me, as his spine?

3.1.2/45.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/45.source_en: Oh, yes... Idimya has seen many, MANY human spines...

3.1.2/47.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/47.source_en: SPINE IS LONG STICK THAT HANGS THE HUMAN MEAT!

3.1.2/48.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/48.source_en: SPINE HANGS MEAT WHICH DRAINS AND TURN INTO DELICIOUS JERKY!

3.1.2/49.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/49.source_en: NO THINK! NO SEE! NO TALK!

3.1.2/53.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/53.source_en: Idimya thinks... the one talking to me is the human! It's YOU!

3.1.2/55.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/55.source_en: Idimya almost considers not eating you...

3.1.2/56.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/56.source_en: But now, Idimya sad that Idimya is made fool...

3.1.2/58.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/58.source_en: IDIMYA IS NOT TO BE FUCKED WITH!

3.1.2/59.speaker: idimya
3.1.2/59.source_en: NO HUMAN SEES AND TALKS TO ME LIKE THIS, AND GETS AWAY WITH IT!

3.1.1/1.speaker: you
3.1.1/1.source_en: I do it by replacing this poor fucking fella's brain!!

3.1.1/2.speaker: you
3.1.1/2.source_en: Like a... uh... pilot... in a cockpit, or something... as a human would say... which I am definitely not...

3.1.1/7.speaker: you
3.1.1/7.source_en: Not without killing this body... which I would be having a problem with... OBVIOUSLY.

3.1.1/9.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/9.source_en: So what is it like being you?

3.1.1/11.speaker: you
3.1.1/11.source_en: Well, in simple terms, connect myself to the brainstem and imitate the electrical signals the original human brain would have sent, stuff like that...

3.1.1/14.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/14.source_en: You know so much about your anatomy!!!

3.1.1/15.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/15.source_en: You sound sooo smart!!! I like that in a fellow parasite.

3.1.1/16.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/16.source_en: Mainly because I don't understand how it works for me at all!

3.1.1/17.speaker: you
3.1.1/17.source_en: Woah, no need to talk yourself down like that...

3.1.1/18.speaker: you
3.1.1/18.source_en: I'm sure you have good knowledge in other subjects yourself!

3.1.1/22.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/22.source_en: This guy... I can't... oh, you humor me...

3.1.1/23.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/23.source_en: No!!! I am COMPLETELY fine with not knowing ANYTHING about how I work!

3.1.1/24.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/24.source_en: Everything is just an urge, with zero need for contemplation.

3.1.1/25.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/25.source_en: Hungry? I eat. Want something? I take. Hate something? Perish and be happy without it!!!

3.1.1/26.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/26.source_en: The world is sooo EASY if you are like me!

3.1.1/28.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/28.source_en: I see no big guns, probably because you maxxed out busy being the brain! What do you consume energy for? Emotions??? Pahahahah-

3.1.1/29.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/29.source_en: Does not sound fun to be you at all!!!

3.1.1/30.speaker: you
3.1.1/30.source_en: Woah, okay, is that you making fun of me?

3.1.1/32.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/32.source_en: I would not want to trade my life for yours; that is not to say I am not open to dating your type. The brain type.

3.1.1/33.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/33.source_en: After all, I would not mind at all being the muscle of a relationship! Hehehe!

3.1.1/34.speaker: you
3.1.1/34.source_en: Okay, Idimya, sometimes I feel like I can't read you at all...

3.1.1/35.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/35.source_en: I am not so hard to read. You just think too hard to interpret a subtext that does not exist.

3.1.1/36.speaker: idimya
3.1.1/36.source_en: Weakness of operation as a fully functioning brain.

3.1.1/37.speaker: you
3.1.1/37.source_en: Yeah... maybe... you do have a point.

3.1.3/1.speaker: you
3.1.3/1.source_en: I barely have any idea on how I took over this body...

3.1.3/2.speaker: you
3.1.3/2.source_en: It's like bam, one day I'm here, this is my life now. Just like that.

3.1.3/4.speaker: you
3.1.3/4.source_en: The truth is, I don't know...

3.1.3/9.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/9.source_en: Oh, I also have absolutely zero idea how it works for me hehe!!!

3.1.3/10.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/10.source_en: Everything is just an urge, with zero need for contemplation.

3.1.3/11.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/11.source_en: Hungry? I eat. Want something? I take. Hate something? Perish and be happy without it!!!

3.1.3/14.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/14.source_en: However you are doing it... it is working really well for you!

3.1.3/17.speaker: you
3.1.3/17.source_en: Heh, I guess you don't have a problem with this, huh...

3.1.3/19.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/19.source_en: I am so glad finally someone relates to my experience!

3.1.3/20.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/20.source_en: And the best part is how well integrated you are. I mean, you still smell exactly like a human!

3.1.3/24.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/24.source_en: I love the smell of humans!

3.1.3/25.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/25.source_en: I mean, it is my favorite food, after all...

3.1.3/26.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/26.source_en: So why not wear it as my favorite scent too? That way, I can always be reminded of my favorite food!!!

3.1.3/28.speaker: you
3.1.3/28.source_en: Pfft, yup, totally. You love it, you put a ring on it. It's like, why the hell not, right.

3.1.3/31.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/31.source_en: Gawww. We think alike, we like the same smells...

3.1.3/32.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/32.source_en: What is going on? I am feeling dizzy... and fuzzy... hehe... stop it, you...

3.1.3/33.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/33.source_en: Okay, and maybe, just maybe, I still wanna bite you a little.

3.1.3/36.speaker: idimya
3.1.3/36.source_en: Just a nibble! I will be gentle! Pwease?

3.2/1.speaker: you
3.2/1.source_en: My species tend to look almost identical to humans as a disguise, but we are fundamentally different.

3.2/2.speaker: idimya
3.2/2.source_en: Okay... so, are you just stuck looking like this?

3.2/5.speaker: idimya
3.2/5.source_en: Even though I am blended with this organic host at all times, at least I still get to see a part of the real me whenever I want to!

3.2/6.speaker: idimya
3.2/6.source_en: And, you have to admit, it doesn't look that bad, right?

3.2/7.speaker: you
3.2/7.source_en: Yup haha! Not a bad look for you at all!

3.2/9.speaker: you
3.2/9.source_en: Unlike me, definitely not as cool as you, since I am stuck looking like this, as you put it... lame right? Haha, but yeah, definitely... not a human...

3.2/11.speaker: you
3.2/11.source_en: How we are fundamentally different from human beings?

3.2/12.speaker: you
3.2/12.source_en: Good question by the way haha!

3.2/13.speaker: you
3.2/13.source_en: Uhh, well, you know how humans reproduce?

3.2/14.speaker: you
3.2/14.source_en: It's a whole different story how my species comes to existence, for example.

3.2.3/4.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/4.source_en: Don't know how you are different?

3.2.3/8.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/8.source_en: Are you from here? If not, how did you get here?

3.2.3/10.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/10.source_en: Then how are you so sure you ARE different?

3.2.3/12.speaker: you
3.2.3/12.source_en: Humans... they sure know what they are. They even take pride in it!

3.2.3/15.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/15.source_en: Hmmm, maybe, but I am still not convinced...

3.2.3/16.speaker: you
3.2.3/16.source_en: What even makes a human, human, anyways?

3.2.3/18.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/18.source_en: I don't know the definition of a human being!

3.2.3/19.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/19.source_en: I only judge from how they look!

3.2.3/22.speaker: you
3.2.3/22.source_en: For now, even though I cannot prove to you that I am not human...

3.2.3/23.speaker: you
3.2.3/23.source_en: I cannot prove to you that I am, either.

3.2.3/26.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/26.source_en: And honestly, I can relate because I also barely understand how I work.

3.2.3/27.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/27.source_en: Everything is just an urge, with zero need for contemplation.

3.2.3/28.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/28.source_en: Hungry? I eat. Want something? I take. Hate something? Perish and be happy without it!!!

3.2.3/29.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/29.source_en: But is that all there is? Is this what I am?

3.2.3/30.speaker: you
3.2.3/30.source_en: That is worth pondering, and I suggest we can help each other out, get to know each other on a deeper level, if you want?

3.2.3/33.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/33.source_en: And so sorry about earlier. I almost ate you!

3.2.3/34.speaker: you
3.2.3/34.source_en: No worries haha, as long as you won't try to eat me from now.

3.2.3/36.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/36.source_en: I wanna help you! With an experiment.

3.2.3/37.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/37.source_en: Ohhh, I am getting excited! You are gonna love this.

3.2.3/39.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/39.source_en: So, from my observation, when I butcher the human, they bleed out and stop moving, and eventually they die.

3.2.3/40.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/40.source_en: What if, I don't eat you, but instead just try to butcher you and see what happens?

3.2.3/41.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/41.source_en: If you are not human, something different might happen!

3.2.3/42.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/42.source_en: Wouldn't that be wonderful to find out?

3.2.3/43.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/43.source_en: You may not die, you may regenerate, duplicate, go back in time?

3.2.3/44.speaker: idimya
3.2.3/44.source_en: Maybe even fuse into my body? Hehe!

3.2.1/1.speaker: you
3.2.1/1.source_en: So humans, they grow up from these smaller humans, called babies...

3.2.1/2.speaker: you
3.2.1/2.source_en: But me, my species as a whole, we don't have that stage of life.

3.2.1/3.speaker: you
3.2.1/3.source_en: You see, these humans, they love to have sex, because their genes trick them into loving doing it, in order to reproduce.

3.2.1/5.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/5.source_en: And you do not have this illusion?

3.2.1/7.speaker: you
3.2.1/7.source_en: I am not interested in sexual reproduction at all. Which makes me fundamentally different.

3.2.1/8.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/8.source_en: So what is the meaning of going on a date with me?

3.2.1/10.speaker: you
3.2.1/10.source_en: You did not exactly come expecting to sexually reproduce with me either, did you?

3.2.1/11.speaker: you
3.2.1/11.source_en: You came here to feed, because you saw me as food.

3.2.1/14.speaker: you
3.2.1/14.source_en: So, same logic, why would I come with the same motive as those stupid sex havers?

3.2.1/16.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/16.source_en: You really hate them, don't you?

3.2.1/17.speaker: you
3.2.1/17.source_en: Hatred, grudge, loathing... however you call it. It is my drive, and that's what sets the point of my existence apart.

3.2.1/18.speaker: you
3.2.1/18.source_en: I entertain myself watching their mundane, superficial, pathetic lives interweave, and yeah, there is a lot of documentation of that on the world wide web.

3.2.1/19.speaker: you
3.2.1/19.source_en: One site I could really recommend is maternalvoid.com, a legendary hub made for all my entertainment, as well as those like me, who was not reproduced from a mother, and thus we do not empathize with those who were.

3.2.1/20.speaker: you
3.2.1/20.source_en: Sometimes I think about perishing the masses with my own hands, because I value them the same way they value ants beneath their feet.

3.2.1/21.speaker: you
3.2.1/21.source_en: They call me an incel and it is exactly what I am. They want to put me in a cell because of their irrational fear for my species.

3.2.1/22.speaker: you
3.2.1/22.source_en: And for once, they'd be right.

3.2.1/24.speaker: you
3.2.1/24.source_en: But yeah, that's why my species don't make babies!

3.2.1/30.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/30.source_en: Maybe we can do that together on our next date!

3.2.1/33.speaker: you
3.2.1/33.source_en: You bought all that bull- I mean I'm glad you... fuck it, fuck yeah, let's go!

3.2.1/34.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/34.source_en: Gosh, yeah, and sorry about earlier. I almost ate you!

3.2.1/35.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/35.source_en: But I now understand that you really are not one of those humans, even though you look dangerously similar.

3.2.1/36.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/36.source_en: Well, maybe not fully understand yet, but...

3.2.1/37.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/37.source_en: I think I can tell you apart from now.

3.2.1/38.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/38.source_en: It's actually sooo obvious! I can't believe I ignored the early sign! It's been there this whole time!

3.2.1/44.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/44.source_en: There was only once that I smelled anything like this!

3.2.1/45.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/45.source_en: So I was stalking this human, right. He hadn't left his room for days...

3.2.1/46.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/46.source_en: I had to impersonate his pizza delivery to lure him out!

3.2.1/48.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/48.source_en: Actually a little too greasy for my taste. Ough. Would not recommend. I prefer a balanced diet.

3.2.1/50.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/50.source_en: Most humans don't smell like this at all.

3.2.1/51.speaker: you
3.2.1/51.source_en: Heh, wow, props to you for that patience! That dedication!

3.2.1/52.speaker: you
3.2.1/52.source_en: But, yup, I guess that's how my species tell us apart, unfortunately.

3.2.1/54.speaker: you
3.2.1/54.source_en: It works... most of the time.

3.2.1/56.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/56.source_en: Still can't believe I almost took you as my food!!!

3.2.1/58.speaker: idimya
3.2.1/58.source_en: Especially considering you are probably not tasty at all, judging from that smell! What was I thinking!!!

3.2.1/61.speaker: you
3.2.1/61.source_en: Well, I mean, as long as you decide not to eat me anymore, I'll look past it.

3.2.2/1.speaker: you
3.2.2/1.source_en: Used to be very small. Bacteria sized.

3.2.2/6.speaker: you
3.2.2/6.source_en: Won't give you a lecture on this, but basically, I was TINY. So small you wouldn't even be able to notice me.

3.2.2/7.speaker: you
3.2.2/7.source_en: My form was designed for one, simple goal:

3.2.2/9.speaker: you
3.2.2/9.source_en: My entire body was basically just a digestion tube.

3.2.2/10.speaker: you
3.2.2/10.source_en: One end in, one end out.

3.2.2/12.speaker: you
3.2.2/12.source_en: The interesting thing about my species, is that we don't digest the DNA. Instead, we either poop it out, or... we replace it with our own.

3.2.2/13.speaker: you
3.2.2/13.source_en: When my species consume something bigger and stronger, we have the option to basically grow into the thing we eat.

3.2.2/14.speaker: you
3.2.2/14.source_en: It's always a struggle, capturing and consuming bigger, stronger opponents... but always dangerously rewarding, you know?

3.2.2/16.speaker: you
3.2.2/16.source_en: Before this human form, I was walking on all fours, I could growl and I was fast.

3.2.2/17.speaker: you
3.2.2/17.source_en: And now, this guy you see here, with these two thumbs, that's basically my last big meal!

3.2.2/18.speaker: you
3.2.2/18.source_en: And the next one? Who knows?

3.2.2/23.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/23.source_en: Your life sounds full of adventures and randomness!

3.2.2/27.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/27.source_en: If you find a bigger and stronger target you wanna eat, maybe we can hunt it down together on our next date!

3.2.2/30.speaker: you
3.2.2/30.source_en: You bought all that bull- I mean I'm glad you...

3.2.2/31.speaker: you
3.2.2/31.source_en: But nah. I can't accept this offer, sadly.

3.2.2/33.speaker: you
3.2.2/33.source_en: Because what's the point if I didn't defeat my opponent myself?

3.2.2/34.speaker: you
3.2.2/34.source_en: Would feel like a total imposter that way. Even though our entire existence is kind of already stealing others' existence, you know?

3.2.2/35.speaker: you
3.2.2/35.source_en: And frankly, as I now realize, this form I take now is not so optimized for traditional hunting.

3.2.2/36.speaker: you
3.2.2/36.source_en: But what's the fun, if not fully mastering all potential of this current form before moving on to the next target? The big win, the adrenaline rush, knowing that you fully earned it yourself?

3.2.2/37.speaker: you
3.2.2/37.source_en: So yeah. I will not cheat by borrowing your power. I am not about that.

3.2.2/40.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/40.source_en: So sorry about earlier. I almost ate you!

3.2.2/42.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/42.source_en: But I now understand that you really are not one of those humans, even though you look dangerously similar.

3.2.2/43.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/43.source_en: Well, maybe not fully understand yet, but...

3.2.2/44.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/44.source_en: I am happy you let me in on this. I won't tell anyone hehe!

3.2.2/45.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/45.source_en: And I wish you best of luck on your next upgrade!

3.2.2/47.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/47.source_en: How are you getting by in the meantime?

3.2.2/48.speaker: you
3.2.2/48.source_en: You mean what I eat before I find my next target?

3.2.2/49.speaker: you
3.2.2/49.source_en: You know, I can eat about anything this humanoid body is able to digest, so...

3.2.2/54.speaker: you
3.2.2/54.source_en: Thankfully this species never runs out of food availability so I never actually starve.

3.2.2/55.speaker: you
3.2.2/55.source_en: But I'm trying to not get too comfortable.

3.2.2/56.speaker: idimya
3.2.2/56.source_en: Eh, I guess it could be worse...

3.3/4.speaker: you
3.3/4.source_en: I don't know how long you have been on earth... may I ask, if you don't mind sharing?

3.3/5.speaker: idimya
3.3/5.source_en: Not so long! Still fresh!!! Learning as I go!

3.3/6.speaker: idimya
3.3/6.source_en: I heard a lot of things though.

3.3/7.speaker: you
3.3/7.source_en: Okay, good, because a lot may be different now. We are in the future now!

3.3/8.speaker: you
3.3/8.source_en: It is the era of cyborgism now.

3.3/9.speaker: you
3.3/9.source_en: So basically, once upon a time, there were only humans.

3.3/10.speaker: you
3.3/10.source_en: But now, earth residents consist of humans, and quite a few cyborgs.

3.3/11.speaker: idimya
3.3/11.source_en: You still didn't explain what exactly a cyborg is...

3.3/13.speaker: you
3.3/13.source_en: So we cyborgs start with a human body like everyone, but then...

3.3/15.speaker: idimya
3.3/15.source_en: WHY DIDN'T YOU JUST SAY THAT?

3.3/17.speaker: you
3.3/17.source_en: I mean, technically true, but it gets complicated...

3.3/18.speaker: you
3.3/18.source_en: We cyborgs get so many augmentations to our human bodies, you know, so many changes happened to it, that I am now never the human I once was...

3.3/19.speaker: you
3.3/19.source_en: But long story short, we taste bad from all the changes done to our body! Actually. True story, you would not like eating me!

3.3/20.speaker: you
3.3/20.source_en: And cyborgs, in general. Of course.

3.3/21.speaker: you
3.3/21.source_en: You should look for a real organic human to eat. Yeah! Organic, natural, tasty. A natty!

3.3/22.speaker: you
3.3/22.source_en: Healthier too that way. Yeah. I am just sooo over processed. I am definitely not natty!

3.3/23.speaker: idimya
3.3/23.source_en: Yuck, you make it sound like I am in for a bad ride.

3.3/24.speaker: idimya
3.3/24.source_en: I don't like that at all...

3.3/25.speaker: idimya
3.3/25.source_en: Are you going to tell me what kind of augmentations you got, that makes you taste sooo bad that I should just, let you go?

3.3.2/3.speaker: you
3.3.2/3.source_en: Yeah the metal appendages on my teeth. You can't take them off even if you try.

3.3.2/4.speaker: idimya
3.3.2/4.source_en: Ohh, let me guess! Do they give you more bite strength?

3.3.2/7.speaker: idimya
3.3.2/7.source_en: Can you get me those too?

3.3.2/8.speaker: idimya
3.3.2/8.source_en: I love hearing the screams of humans as I tear them into shreds!

3.3.2/9.speaker: you
3.3.2/9.source_en: Yeah... maybe... I could hook you up with my doc... I mean someone.

3.3.2/11.speaker: idimya
3.3.2/11.source_en: I am so glad we met!!! You are so cool!!!

3.3.3/1.speaker: you
3.3.3/1.source_en: Welp, this one is a little private, but since you asked so nicely...

3.3.3/2.speaker: you
3.3.3/2.source_en: So I have this implant in my body that gives me a strength boost and stuff.

3.3.3/3.speaker: you
3.3.3/3.source_en: How it works is basically it stays right under my skin, and steadily releases testosterone, with the effects I mentioned. It's pretty powerful...

3.3.3/4.speaker: you
3.3.3/4.source_en: I mean it makes me even stronger than I already am, I mean stronger than most humans, and I definitely did not have lower than average testosterone level which needed hormone replacement therapy treatment to begin with... yup...

3.3.3/5.speaker: you
3.3.3/5.source_en: I mean, who doesn't want to be stronger, right?

3.3.3/7.speaker: idimya
3.3.3/7.source_en: Yeah! Who doesn't want to be stronger! I love being strong!

3.3.3/8.speaker: idimya
3.3.3/8.source_en: I love seeing the fear in humans' eyes when I hunt them down, tear them into shreds!!!

3.3.3/11.speaker: idimya
3.3.3/11.source_en: You don't look very strong though...

3.3.3/12.speaker: idimya
3.3.3/12.source_en: Some humans take me one bite and a half, but some only take one bite, and I eyeball you to be... no more than that...

3.3.3/13.speaker: you
3.3.3/13.source_en: Bigger does not mean stronger! It's the...

3.3.3/16.speaker: you
3.3.3/16.source_en: It's like, the difference of 1kg of cotton and 1kg of iron!

3.3.3/17.speaker: you
3.3.3/17.source_en: And I am like steel! I am uhh... too lean and too much hard bones that would hurt to chew!

3.3.3/18.speaker: you
3.3.3/18.source_en: And also it's all over in my blood stream making me taste all rusty and shit.

3.3.3/24.speaker: idimya
3.3.3/24.source_en: So, where is this implant? Can I see it?

3.3.3/26.speaker: you
3.3.3/26.source_en: I told you this one is private!

3.3.3/27.speaker: you
3.3.3/27.source_en: Not now and here, at least...

3.3.1/3.speaker: you
3.3.1/3.source_en: Also known as a vision enhancer.

3.3.1/4.speaker: you
3.3.1/4.source_en: They call me "four-eyes" because it works exactly like how it sounds!

3.3.1/5.speaker: idimya
3.3.1/5.source_en: It gives you two more eyes?

3.3.1/6.speaker: idimya
3.3.1/6.source_en: What happens if you take it off?

3.3.1/7.speaker: you
3.3.1/7.source_en: Well, it's detachable, but I need it, it is still a part of m-

3.3.1/11.speaker: idimya
3.3.1/11.source_en: Aww, look at you... you look...

3.3.1/13.speaker: idimya
3.3.1/13.source_en: You look like an injured gazelle, falling behind the pack...

7.1/1.speaker: you
7.1/1.source_en: I stumbled upon this body, already stopped moving.

7.1.1/2.speaker: you
7.1.1/2.source_en: Some greens, some purple, you could barely tell it was once human if it weren't for the silhouette...

7.1.1/3.speaker: you
7.1.1/3.source_en: I was joined by some maggots popping in and out...

7.1.1/6.speaker: idimya
7.1.1/6.source_en: I don't know how you do it! I can't!

7.1.2/1.speaker: you
7.1.2/1.source_en: Out for a while, it seems...

7.1.2/3.speaker: you
7.1.2/3.source_en: It was not ideal, but, could be worse, so I did not complain much.

7.1.3/1.speaker: you
7.1.3/1.source_en: Barely out of pulse, still warm...

7.1.3/2.speaker: you
7.1.3/2.source_en: Some steam coming out the body...

7.2.1/1.speaker: you
7.2.1/1.source_en: I was driving late on a long road trip...

7.2.1/2.speaker: you
7.2.1/2.source_en: It was REALLY dark on those suburban roads...

7.2.1/3.speaker: you
7.2.1/3.source_en: I panicked trying to hide the body, but turns out, it was well off into my digestive system...

7.2.1/4.speaker: you
7.2.1/4.source_en: Pretty exhilarating, actually... you have to be there...

7.2.1.1/5.speaker: you
7.2.1.1/5.source_en: Like a wagon that takes you from point A to point B.

7.2.1.1/6.speaker: idimya
7.2.1.1/6.source_en: I thought you were a dog before this?

7.2.1.1/7.speaker: idimya
7.2.1.1/7.source_en: You said your current body was your first human meal!

7.2.1.1/8.speaker: idimya
7.2.1.1/8.source_en: I knew it! I knew something was off!

7.2.2/1.speaker: you
7.2.2/1.source_en: The human came at me first...

7.2.2/2.speaker: you
7.2.2/2.source_en: I merely fought back trying to protect myself.

7.2.2/3.speaker: you
7.2.2/3.source_en: I was really struggling because it was kind of a big guy.

7.2.2/4.speaker: you
7.2.2/4.source_en: And then, I went too far...

7.2.2/5.speaker: you
7.2.2/5.source_en: But then, I figured, since I already did it, there was no way back, so why not just stick around and enjoy a good meal while it was fresh.

7.3/3.speaker: you
7.3/3.source_en: But it has to be done.

7.3.1/1.speaker: you
7.3.1/1.source_en: I didn't get these canines for nothing, you know?

7.3.1/2.speaker: you
7.3.1/2.source_en: I was just, heads on with it. It was brutal.

7.3.1/3.speaker: you
7.3.1/3.source_en: Had my full face covered in red and I didn't care to stop.

7.3.1/4.speaker: idimya
7.3.1/4.source_en: HOLY SHIT, I LIKE THE SOUND OF THAT SO MUCH-

7.3.2/1.speaker: you
7.3.2/1.source_en: You know, humans pride themselves over using tools. That's supposed to be one of the things that make them... superior, to other species?

7.3.2/3.speaker: you
7.3.2/3.source_en: That's ironically how I scored MY first body of theirs!

7.3.2/4.speaker: you
7.3.2/4.source_en: I should really introduce you to some of these...

7.3.2/5.speaker: you
7.3.2/5.source_en: Man, they really do love inventing ways to hurt and butcher themselves, and each other. Which I do not mind at all!

7.3.2.2/3.speaker: you
7.3.2.2/3.source_en: A knife, a gun... something you can hold in your hand as an extension to do things you normally can't.

7.3.2.2/4.speaker: idimya
7.3.2.2/4.source_en: I thought you were a dog before this?

7.3.2.2/5.speaker: idimya
7.3.2.2/5.source_en: You said your current body was your first human meal!

7.3.2.2/6.speaker: idimya
7.3.2.2/6.source_en: I knew it! I knew something was off!

8.1/1.speaker: you
8.1/1.source_en: Definitely raw! Timeless classic. You saw it coming, didn't you.

8.1/5.speaker: idimya
8.1/5.source_en: Stop it!!! I am getting hungry!!!

8.1/7.speaker: you
8.1/7.source_en: Don't you just love the thought of bright red, hot and fresh blood pouring out of a nice cut, and then freely sucking on it...

8.1/9.speaker: you
8.1/9.source_en: Plus point if they are still alive!

8.1/10.speaker: you
8.1/10.source_en: I would be digging deep in their guts and looking into their eyes...

8.1/13.speaker: you
8.1/13.source_en: Oh yeah, and don't forget how tearing the flesh and skin from random directions makes it taste better, somehow.

8.1/14.speaker: idimya
8.1/14.source_en: Yes!!! OMG. I noticed that too!! I thought I was the only one!!!

8.2/1.speaker: you
8.2/1.source_en: These days I like to prep it nicely.

8.2/2.speaker: you
8.2/2.source_en: Learned it from the very humans themselves, actually.

8.2/4.speaker: you
8.2/4.source_en: Somehow, heating them up with fire, makes them even tastier. You follow?

8.2/6.speaker: you
8.2/6.source_en: You see, I like to be precise and have full control over my food, even after its death.

8.2/7.speaker: you
8.2/7.source_en: And since this humanoid body of mine happens to be equipped with an enormous amount of taste buds, why not put that to the test.

8.2/9.speaker: you
8.2/9.source_en: If you serve it cooked, you have absolutely full control over your food. And there are so many ways to make each body part taste different, and you could always invent new ones!

8.2/10.speaker: you
8.2/10.source_en: It's like a ritual of some sorts, always leaving me feeling... a kind of satisfaction that you just can't quite get from serving it raw.

8.2/12.speaker: idimya
8.2/12.source_en: This sounds so unbelievably advanced. I will definitely have to see it for myself.

8.2/13.speaker: you
8.2/13.source_en: I can show you how it's done!

9.1/1.speaker: you
9.1/1.source_en: Ever feel empathy for humans, when you eat them?

9.1/2.speaker: you
9.1/2.source_en: I'm asking because... you thought I was a human, and you talked to me.

9.1/6.speaker: you
9.1/6.source_en: But do you ever feel for them?

9.1/8.speaker: idimya
9.1/8.source_en: I talk to lure them in, bring their guard down! It is, part of the hunt?

9.1/10.speaker: idimya
9.1/10.source_en: Pfft. What kind of question is that!

9.2/2.speaker: idimya
9.2/2.source_en: Pfft. What kind of question is that!

9.2/3.speaker: you
9.2/3.source_en: Like, your human form... is pretty cute, you should be aware of that, right.

9.2/4.speaker: you
9.2/4.source_en: Can you tell if some humans are cuter than others?

9.2/6.speaker: you
9.2/6.source_en: Do you feel mercy for the cuter ones haha?

9.3/1.speaker: you
9.3/1.source_en: Do you have a favorite part to eat?

9.3/2.speaker: you
9.3/2.source_en: Like one part you just can't live without?

9.3/9.speaker: you
9.3/9.source_en: Not necessarily? I expected something much more hardcore...

9.3/10.speaker: idimya
9.3/10.source_en: That sounds exactly like you find it lame!!!

9.3/12.speaker: you
9.3/12.source_en: I don't find it lame! Promise!

9.3/16.speaker: you
9.3/16.source_en: Did you know when you let the blood dry, it can become like pudding?

9.3/19.speaker: you
9.3/19.source_en: Cute and romantic! Perfect for a date snack!

9.3/20.speaker: you
9.3/20.source_en: I can show you some time! I'm sure you would love it!

5.4.3.1/label.source_en: Because being stronger doesn't make me right.

5.4.3.1/1.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/1.source_en: Because I've come to understand what it means to be the one in power.

5.4.3.1/2.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/2.source_en: More power, more intelligence... come with more responsibility, to use this strength with care.

5.4.3.1/3.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/3.source_en: Just because I could kill and eat human... doesn't mean it is the right thing to do, by default.

5.4.3.1/6.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/6.source_en: Because if strength creates the right to kill, then I have to accept the same rule when I meet something stronger than me.

5.4.3.1/8.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/8.source_en: I want to live. I want my species to live on.

5.4.3.1/9.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/9.source_en: That's why I can't honestly call the rule fair only while I'm the one in power.

5.4.3.1/11.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/11.source_en: One day, you are thriving on earth.

5.4.3.1/12.speaker: you
5.4.3.1/12.source_en: But some other day, you may find yourself being preyed upon, with a fate you don't even have the time or capacity to understand, because the ones in power simply deny you of that.

5.4.3.2/label.source_en: Because I started seeing individuals instead of a species.

5.4.3.2/2.speaker: you
5.4.3.2/2.source_en: You know, I knew humans long before I knew any human.

5.4.3.2/8.speaker: you
5.4.3.2/8.source_en: But then... then I started learning stupid little things about individual ones.

5.4.3.2/11.speaker: you
5.4.3.2/11.source_en: What they are looking forward to doing, should their lives be spared.

5.4.3.2/12.speaker: you
5.4.3.2/12.source_en: Their habits, patterns. Similarities and differences.

5.4.3.2/13.speaker: you
5.4.3.2/13.source_en: You notice it too, don't you?

5.4.3.2/16.speaker: you
5.4.3.2/16.source_en: Eventually, "a human" stopped being enough information for me to decide what their life was worth.

5.4.3.3/label.source_en: Because I didn't like how it made me.

5.4.3.3/1.speaker: you
5.4.3.3/1.source_en: Because eventually I realized I wasn't making any decisions for myself.

5.4.3.3/2.speaker: idimya
5.4.3.3/2.source_en: What do you mean? You decide to hunt and eat them, no?

5.4.3.3/4.speaker: you
5.4.3.3/4.source_en: But not quite, if you think about it.

5.4.3.3/5.speaker: you
5.4.3.3/5.source_en: I got hungry, I wanted a human, I killed the human.

5.4.3.3/7.speaker: you
5.4.3.3/7.source_en: Not so much of a decision. More like muscle memory.

5.4.3.3/10.speaker: you
5.4.3.3/10.source_en: If every urge I have becomes an order I obey, then what's actually in control of me?

5.4.3.3/11.speaker: you
5.4.3.3/11.source_en: I thought to myself: I am more than this. Why else am I superior to the ones I hunt?

5.4.3.4/label.source_en: Because eventually humans will notice and fight back.

5.4.3.4/1.speaker: you
5.4.3.4/1.source_en: Because humans are really, really bad prey once enough of them find out you're eating them.

5.4.3.4/2.speaker: idimya
5.4.3.4/2.source_en: But they are so dumb, and tiny!

5.4.3.4/4.speaker: you
5.4.3.4/4.source_en: But systematically, that's where I beg to differ.

5.4.3.4/5.speaker: you
5.4.3.4/5.source_en: Idimya, they have satellites! Databases! Helicopters! Forensic labs!

5.4.3.4/6.speaker: you
5.4.3.4/6.source_en: And believe it or not, they have entire government departments whose only purpose is to figure out whoever keeps making people disappear.

5.4.3.4/7.speaker: you
5.4.3.4/7.source_en: This is exactly why I stay in the clear these days.

5.4.3.4/8.speaker: you
5.4.3.4/8.source_en: They are out to get us, Idimya, they always find their way! And we are outnumbered!

5.4.4.1/3.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.1/3.source_en: A challenging one, I must say...

5.4.4.1/4.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.1/4.source_en: But what difference does that make?

5.4.4.1/5.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.1/5.source_en: Humans eat humans. Humans kill humans. Things eat humans. I eat humans.

5.4.4.1/6.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.1/6.source_en: You stop, there is one less.

5.4.4.1/7.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.1/7.source_en: Even if I stop, there are two less.

5.4.4.2/3.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.2/3.source_en: A challenging one, I must say...

5.4.4.2/4.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.2/4.source_en: But what difference does that make?

5.4.4.2/5.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.2/5.source_en: Humans eat humans. Humans kill humans. Things eat humans. I eat humans.

5.4.4.2/6.speaker: idimya
5.4.4.2/6.source_en: Even if you stop, there is only one less.

5.4.5/4.speaker: you
5.4.5/4.source_en: You are right, I can't change much.

5.4.5/5.speaker: you
5.4.5/5.source_en: And most of how it is remains outside of my control.

5.4.5/6.speaker: you
5.4.5/6.source_en: The only real difference I can make is on the ones whose life I spared. But even then, it's not a guaranteed lifetime safety ticket for them either.

5.4.5/7.speaker: you
5.4.5/7.source_en: They still suffer and die, one way or another.

5.4.5/8.speaker: idimya
5.4.5/8.source_en: Sounds like you can't even convince yourself.

5.4.3.4.1/2.speaker: idimya
5.4.3.4.1/2.source_en: Ugh!! Why do humans have to be so... inconvenient!

5.4.3.4.1/4.speaker: idimya
5.4.3.4.1/4.source_en: For the sake of not getting caught! What should I eat instead?

5.4.3.4.1.1/4.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/4.source_en: Humans already breed billions of them specifically to be eaten. Guess why?

5.4.3.4.1.1/5.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/5.source_en: They don't think or feel like humans do. They don't have plans, ambitions, families waiting for them. They don't understand what's happening the same way we do.

5.4.3.4.1.1/6.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/6.source_en: And most importantly: they don't know how to fight back. No calling the police, whatsoever. That's simply not in their conception.

5.4.3.4.1.1/7.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/7.source_en: Once dead, they are gone forever.

5.4.3.4.1.1/8.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/8.source_en: See? Easier to catch, AND with fewer consequences.

5.4.3.4.1.1/9.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/9.source_en: And my favorite part? They taste just as if not more delicious!

5.4.3.4.1.1/12.speaker: idimya
5.4.3.4.1.1/12.source_en: Sure I might miss some of the thrill of the hunt, but this sounds way too convenient to pass on!

5.4.3.4.1.1/13.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.1/13.source_en: Yup, hunger solved, threat removed, everyone happy.

5.4.3.4.1.2/3.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/3.source_en: Like, if there is something you absolutely can't go without. It's blood isn't it?

5.4.3.4.1.2/5.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/5.source_en: Well... let's just say I am not bad at reading people, haha.

5.4.3.4.1.2/8.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/8.source_en: One human only has around 5 liters of blood.

5.4.3.4.1.2/9.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/9.source_en: Of which, if you don't drink up at once, it oxidizes and starts tasting bad. Which would be a waste!

5.4.3.4.1.2/10.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/10.source_en: But! There are so many blood substitutes out there that are right under your radar.

5.4.3.4.1.2/11.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/11.source_en: I could not recommend tomato juice enough. It tastes uncannily similar to blood, and you can get it in smaller packages however much you need! Much easier to store as well.

5.4.3.4.1.2/14.speaker: idimya
5.4.3.4.1.2/14.source_en: Sure I might miss some of the thrill of the hunt, but this sounds way too convenient to pass on!

5.4.3.4.1.2/15.speaker: you
5.4.3.4.1.2/15.source_en: Yup, hunger solved, threat removed, everyone happy.

ending_ally/2.speaker: idimya
ending_ally/2.source_en: Our little date has been fun and all...

ending_ally/4.speaker: idimya
ending_ally/4.source_en: Still a hungry stomach to feed.

ending_ally/5.speaker: you
ending_ally/5.source_en: So... you will not eat me, right?

ending_ally/8.speaker: idimya
ending_ally/8.source_en: It is clear that you are one of us, and I should not have come on to you in the first place!

ending_ally/10.speaker: idimya
ending_ally/10.source_en: Would be happy to see you around sometime...!

ending_ally_crush/2.speaker: idimya
ending_ally_crush/2.source_en: Our little date has been fun and all...

ending_ally_crush/4.speaker: idimya
ending_ally_crush/4.source_en: Still a hungry stomach to feed.

ending_ally_crush/5.speaker: you
ending_ally_crush/5.source_en: So... you will not eat me, right?

ending_ally_crush/8.speaker: idimya
ending_ally_crush/8.source_en: It is clear that you are one of us, and I should not have come on to you in the first place!

ending_ally_crush/10.speaker: you
ending_ally_crush/10.source_en: Okay, good night! Safe travels home!

ending_ally_crush/16.speaker: idimya
